messages:
maya: Quick sync — prioritizing observability console work for Q3 OKR. Need decisions on dashboards, tracing retention, error analysis, and launch criteria. TL;DR: several larger customers asked for 30d+ retention; infra concerned about cost. Can we agree a GA scope today?

arjun: short version: we can do tiered retention but raw trace retention >7d spikes costs a lot (KV cache + storage). Recommend default 7d raw traces, aggregated error metrics 90d, paid tiers for 30/90/365 with export to S3.

kelly: UX idea — retention presets (default, pro-30d, enterprise-365) and an advanced modal for per-service overrides. Keep the dashboard list simple, but allow saved queries and a share link.

sam: logging note — need retention controls wired to retention policy service and billing tags. Also: alerting for sudden increase in trace volume to avoid surprise bills. We should require a migration path for customers who want long-term retention (S3/Parquet export).

lee: Customer feedback: BankCo and HealthCo want 1 year retention + audit log exports for compliance. They're willing to pay, but want clear SLAs around data durability and access. Also asked for more powerful error grouping (fingerprinting) and a way to correlate traces with user IDs.

maya: Proposed GA scope (minimal):
- Dashboards: saved queries, basic widget library, export CSV/PNG
- Error analysis: grouping, basic regression alerts, quick filters (service/env/version)
- Tracing/retention: default 7d raw, aggregated metrics 90d; add paid 30/90/365 tiers and S3 export for long-term
- Launch criteria: docs + quickstart, RBAC for retention controls, perf budget: page load p90 < 200ms for dashboard listing, end-to-end tracing ingestion < 250ms from SDK -> console index

arjun: agree with minimal. We should postpone per-span retention UI and per-attribute indexing for post-GA. Also need to estimate infra cost delta: I'll get a projection for 30/90/365 tiers.

kelly: For launch let's ship presets + a single advanced modal. Post-GA we do per-service experiment. Mockups incoming by Tue.

sam: ops checklist: canary rollout 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%, monitor cost, ingestion rate, query latency. Add automatic fallback to aggregated-only view if raw traces exceed budget.

maya: OKRs tied to this:
- O1: Decrease mean time to identify root cause (MTTR) by 30% for customers using console features
- O2: Increase adoption of console dashboards to 20% of active customers
- O3: Drive revenue from retention tiers $Xk MRR (TBD)
Key results = telemetry events, adoption, revenue.

lee: Launch ask from sales: include a clear SKUs doc and a one-pager for enterprise security/audit. I'll draft and share.

arjun: quick config example for export (for the infra folks):
```yaml
retention:
  default_days: 7
  tiers:
    - name: pro
      raw_days: 30
      price: "contact-sales"
    - name: enterprise
      raw_days: 365
      export: s3
      price: "enterprise"
export_job:
  schedule: daily
  sink: s3://redwood-exports/<customer-id>/traces/
```

kelly: UX constraint — keep the default flow 1 click to enable export and schedule. Advanced users can customize.

maya: Launch acceptance criteria checklist (short):
- Instrumentation + SDK support for trace IDs and user mapping: done
- Dashboard saved queries + widget gallery: done
- Retention presets + modal: done
- Export to S3 job + documentation: done
- Billing + SKU docs: done
- Canary rollout plan + cost monitors: done

sam: Also add regression test: simulate 5x ingestion and validate fallback doesn't drop critical metrics.

arjun: I'll own infra estimate and export implementation. ETA: infra spike + PRs by next Fri.

kelly: I'll upload initial mockups (Figma link) by Tuesday and iterate with Maya.

lee: I'll coordinate with Sales for the one-pager and a short beta invite list (BankCo, HealthCo).

maya: Decision: GA scope locked to minimal list above. Post-GA backlog: per-span retention, per-attribute indexing, advanced tracing UI. If any blockers, call out by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout plan created: 2025-06-05 00:00 UTC -> stages: 1%/5%/25%/100% with rollback window 1h.

maya: Thanks. I'll publish this to the roadmap doc and add OKR targets. If anyone has strong objections to scope, reply here. :rocket:
